runner.description: Test runner. Default: angular when the project's test target uses @nx/angular:unit-test, else vitest with <projectRoot>/vite.config.ts.

exclude.description: Workspace-relative globs of source files never to mutate in this project.

tier.description: Mutate only the files of one tier (see tools/stryker/config.mjs).

run.description: Run name: output goes to tmp/stryker/<run>/. Defaults to the project name, plus -<tier> for a tier run.

mutate.description: Scoped run: mutate these files or globs (file.ts:10-40 for a line range) instead of the config's list.

concurrency.description: Number of Stryker workers (each runs its own Angular build). Default 4.

dryRunOnly.description: Instrument and run the initial test run only; no mutants are tested.

incremental.description: Reuse results from tmp/stryker/<run>/incremental.json for unchanged code and tests.

logLevel.description: Stryker log level. trace includes the Angular build output of the workers.

listFiles.description: Print the files that would be mutated, with their tier, and exit.
